text: I wake up at six-thirty every morning. After a quick shower, I have a light breakfast of toast and coffee while checking the news on my phone. By eight, I’m at my desk, starting work. My schedule is fairly predictable: I answer emails, attend meetings, and focus on my main projects until lunch. In the afternoon, I usually take a short walk to clear my head. After work, I go to the gym three times a week; on other days, I simply stretch at home. In the evening, I cook dinner, read a book, or watch a series. I’m in bed by eleven. This routine gives me a sense of control, and I find that consistency helps me stay productive and calm.
